title: Add a /health endpoint
notes: Kiro IDE session.json + messages.jsonl. Three of the four lifecycle payloads (turn_start, usage_summary, turn_end) are not messages and must not appear in the count. session_start is: its `content` is the prompt that opened the session, written once on the first turn with no `user` payload beside it, and replayed as a human message by Kiro's own model-context rebuild — so it is the first User row here, ahead of the mid-turn `user` payload. Workspace comes from workspacePaths[0]; the bucket directory is a one-way sha256 prefix and names nothing.
